title: Greek salad with grilled chicken
steps: Season the chicken with oregano, salt and pepper and cook it in a griddle pan with a little oil for 5–6 minutes per side, then rest briefly.
Cut the cucumber, tomatoes and pepper into chunks and the onion into thin rings.
Toss the vegetables with the olives, remaining oil and lemon juice.
Slice the chicken, arrange it on the salad, crumble the feta over and serve with pitta.
